name: 47562 · Odon, IN
findings: ZIP 47562 (Odon) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 47562 (Odon) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 47562 (Odon) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
